## Summary
Sprint 2 successfully delivered all planned sprint backlog items: US-0002 (Client Daemon Lifecycle & Metrics Collector) and US-0003 (Client Daemon Power Assertion and Sleep Prevention). - Addressed backlog prioritization ordering and established retrospective action to validate dependency ordering during sprint planning.
